 Print Picture Credit: YouTube screengrab Actor Ruhani Sharma is set to return to Telugu cinema with the upcoming Dulquer Salmaan starrer ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’. Ahead of the film's theatrical release, the actress spoke about her role, her connection with the story and why she wanted to be part of the project. She also praised Dulquer’s choice of films and encouraged women to pursue their dreams. Ruhani Sharma connects with ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ story
 Ruhani Sharma plays a character named Bijili in the Pavan Sadineni directorial. During the film’s pre-release event, she revealed that the film's story had a personal connection with her because she comes from a small village in Himachal Pradesh. Watch Bhagyashrii Borse Reveals She Was Not Ready To Slap Dulquer Salmaan In Kaantha "I personally connected with this story because I come from a small village in Himachal Pradesh. I have always believed that our circumstances should never stop us from pursuing our dreams. The character Bijili is very special to me. It is not about the screen time but about how a character contributes to the story and takes it forward. That is what matters," she said as quoted by Cinema Express in Telugu loosely translated in English. The actress added that this was one of the reasons she wanted to be part of the film. She also thanked the director for writing the role for her. "Like the girl in this story, I too come from a small town in Himachal Pradesh. Back then, if someone had told me that I would become an actress and stand on a stage like this, I would never have believed them. We should never limit our dreams because of our circumstances," she said. Join conversation

 Ruhani Sharma praises Dulquer Salmaan's film choices
 Ruhani also praised Dulquer Salmaan for choosing films that give importance to female characters and their journeys. "In Dulquer Salmaan garu's films, the female characters are really beautiful. Thank you for choosing scripts that celebrate women, their journeys and their identities. I am really grateful to have worked with you and hope to work with you in more films," she said. In her speech, Ruhani Sharma also encouraged women and young girls to dream big and not allow their circumstances to hold them back. ‘Aakasamlo Oka’ Tara stars Dulquer Salmaan and debutant Satvika Veeravalli, with Shruti Haasan and Ruhani Sharma in important roles. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on November 20.
